items.note: Negative request: the ない-form of とります (take a photo) plus でください, "please don't do X," the mirror of てください "please do X" (Lesson 18/19). とる is a Regular 1 verb: とる→とらない. It is a fairly firm instruction; giving a reason first with から (kara), as in 〜ですから、〜ないでください, softens it. Between friends, drop ください: とらないで.

Same ないでください pattern as とらないでください this lesson, here with とめます (park). とめる is Regular 2: とめる→とめない. The ない-form inside is casual, but ください makes the whole request polite. Between friends, drop ください: とめないで.
Regular 2: ない-form いれない (irenai), dictionary form いれる (ireru).

いれます (put in) is Regular 2: ない-form いれない + でください, the same "please don't" pattern as とらないでください and とめないでください this lesson. The ない-form inside is casual, but ください makes the whole request polite. Between friends, drop ください: いれないで.
すいます here means "smoke/inhale," a different verb from すわります "sit" (Lesson 21) despite looking similar. Its ない-form is すわない (う→わ), not すわらない.
たちいり (going into a place) + きんし (prohibited). The same きんし ends ちゅうしゃきんし.
ちゅうしゃ (parking, the word inside ちゅうしゃじょう, parking lot) + きんし (prohibited), the same きんし as in たちいりきんし.
A set sign word. It does not use きんし like たちいりきんし and ちゅうしゃきんし, though its きん also means "prohibited".
